designationHistory.indexText: The federal government and the State of California acquired the Headwaters Forest, which became the Headwaters Forest Reserve under BLM management.

authority.citation: Acquisition authorized by Public Law 105-83, title V, sec. 501, 111 Stat. 1543, 1610 (approved Nov. 14, 1997)

designationHistory.note: No act or proclamation 'designates' the Reserve. Public Law 105-83 (signed by President Clinton, Nov. 14, 1997) authorized the purchase and named the retained land the 'Headwaters Forest'; the 2002 Federal Register notice and the BLM page date the acquisition and establishment to March 1, 1999. The BLM page labels it a 'Congressional Designation.'
